approvedSentences.imageNotes: Classroom or activity room after a ribbon craft class. Show used colorful ribbons or ribbon work on the table, and a window or doorway where the outside sky is getting late. The image should clearly show class has ended and the sky is late. No written text, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signs, or watermarks.

Outdoor cold-weather scene. Use the recurring protagonist girl identity wearing warmer clothing while looking at tree leaves that have turned red. Make both cold weather and red leaves clear. No written text, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signs, or watermarks.

Use the recurring protagonist mother and recurring protagonist girl identities. Mother looks pale and sits or rests gently; the protagonist girl is nearby showing care. Keep the image warm and mild, not severe, frightening, or medical-emergency-like. No written text, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signs, or watermarks.
